mapper.select: /* LeaveHourlyResettleMapper.selectHourlyLeaveRowsOnDate */ SELECT U.LEAVE_ID AS leaveId , U.GRANT_ID AS grantId , U.LEAVE_MINUTES AS leaveMinutes , U.LEAVE_DAYS AS leaveDays , U.START_TIME AS startTime FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.START_DATE = #{workYmd} AND U.USE_UNIT_TYPE IN ('02', '03', '04') AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY U.START_TIME ASC, U.LEAVE_ID ASC
